def transform(grid):

    seen = set()
    objs = []

            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                        grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            H, W = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
            boundary = {(y,x) for y,x in cells
                        if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            is_frame = (len(boundary) == 2*H+2*W-4 and
                        all((y,x) in cells for y,x in boundary))
            objs.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,cells,is_frame))

    # Copy the interior pattern of each non-frame object into the frame
    # with the same bounding-box dimensions.
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,cells,is_frame in objs:
        if not is_frame:
            continue
        H, W = r1-r0+1, c1-c0+1
        source = next((o for o in objs
                       if o[0] != color and not o[6]
                       and o[2]-o[1]+1 == H and o[4]-o[3]+1 == W), None)

    return out
